summary: Circle8 Group filed an 8-K after issuing a press release confirming a preliminary, non-binding and highly indicative proposal to acquire SThree plc (LSE: STEM.L), a specialist STEM staffing business, advancing its global IT and technology strategy. The filing states the approach is at an early stage with no certainty any firm offer will be made; no price per share, premium, stake percentage or expected close date were disclosed. The London-listed target's Takeover Code announcement governs the process, so a 28-day 'put up or shut up' regulatory clock is the key mechanic. Watch for a possible firm offer or lapse as the risk-arb catalyst.
